header: Find the price list for your organisation
subheader: Three price lists, because a single practice and a rehabilitation centre need different things.
lead: Choose the one that fits your organisation. If you are between two, take the smaller one: moving up later is free and keeps all appointments.
note: All prices are net, in euros, for Austria. Germany pays the same prices; other countries get an individual quote.

routes.title: A single practice
routes.description: 1 to 15 practitioners at up to three addresses. Published prices, monthly billing and no minimum term.

routes.title: A group or institution
routes.description: More than 15 practitioners, or a formal procurement process. A written offer with prices fixed for the term.

routes.title: A teaching institution
routes.description: Universities and training providers that use Talbrunn in class, with sample data only.
